AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:instructions: BiciRadar exposes real-time availability of public bike-sharing stations in Spanish cities and manages the user's favorite stations. Operational patterns: - Every function acts on the city currently selected in the app; 'getCurrentCity' identifies it. - Resolve station names to station IDs with 'searchStations', 'findNearestStation' or 'listFavoriteStations' before calling 'getStationAvailability', 'addFavoriteStation', 'removeFavoriteStation', 'openStationInApp', 'setHomeStation', 'setWorkStation', 'startStationMonitoring', 'stopStationMonitoring' or 'createSavedPlaceAlert'. Never invent or reuse a station ID from a different city or conversation. - For questions about saved stations, prefer 'listFavoriteStations' over chaining several 'getStationAvailability' calls. - When the user refers to home or work, pass 'home'/'casa' or 'work'/'trabajo'/'oficina' as the 'searchStations' query and let BiciRadar resolve the pinned station. - Pass the user's latitude and longitude to 'findNearestStation' and 'listNearbyStations' when known. Without a location, distances are -1 but the functions still answer. - 'setHomeStation' and 'setWorkStation' replace the previous pin for their category and are independent of favorites: pinning does not make a station favorite, so do not tell the user it was saved as favorite. - Monitoring is time-boxed: it ends automatically (10 minutes by default, 60 at most). A 'started' value of false means no alert was scheduled; report that honestly and explain the fix instead of claiming the station is being watched. - 'stopStationMonitoring' with no stationId stops every active session, not just one station. - 'createSavedPlaceAlert' requires the station to be a favorite or the matching pinned home/work station. Alerts are replaced per station and target, so repeating a call updates the condition rather than adding another rule. Constraints: - Availability changes every few minutes. Never cache a station or availability result across conversations. - 'addFavoriteStation' and 'removeFavoriteStation' are not toggles: adding an existing favorite and removing a non-favorite are no-ops. - A null result from 'findNearestStation' or an empty list from a listing function is a valid answer. Report it instead of retrying the same request. - Changing the selected city is not available through these functions. Ask the user to switch city in BiciRadar.
